answer: A clone farm wins a jury only by filling it. So draw each 4-seat grading panel from four different islands: communities found by clustering who attests and grades alongside whom over the last 20 epochs. Clones that mirror each other's attestations form one tight island, and an island gets at most one seat per panel, so 100 clones hold the same 1-in-4 voice as a single ID and can never set a median alone. Each extra clone adds influence at its nadir: zero. A second seat means earning trust in a second, separate community. Window and panel size are my assumptions.
